name: nvr-mobile
description: The NVR web interface in a native iOS and Android shell (Capacitor).

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
